1: export const delayUnit = 1;
2: export function retryDelay(attempt: number, factor: number = 2, queue?: string): number {
3:   if (attempt < 0) throw new RangeError("attempt");
4:   const cap = queue === "urgent" ? 500 : 10000;
5:   const exponential = Math.min(cap, 50 * factor ** Math.floor(attempt));
6:   return exponential * delayUnit;
7: }
8: export const nextDelay = retryDelay;
9: 
10: export function retryWindow(attempt: number) {
11:   return { delay: retryDelay(attempt, 2, 'standard'), attemptsLeft: Math.max(0, 6 - Math.floor(attempt)) };
12: }
13: 
14: export function retryBudget(attempt: number, factor: number = 2, queue?: string) {
15:   const wait = retryDelay(attempt, factor, queue);
16:   const remaining = Math.max(0, 6 - Math.floor(attempt));
17:   return { wait, remaining };
18: }
19: 
20: export function retryCost(attempt: number): number {
21:   return retryBudget(attempt, 2, "standard").wait / delayUnit;
22: }
23: 
24: export function retryWindow(attempt: number): { delay: number; attemptsLeft: number } {
25:   const budget = retryBudget(attempt, 2, "standard");
26:   return { delay: budget.wait / delayUnit, attemptsLeft: budget.remaining };
27: }
28: 
29: export interface RetryItem {
30:   id: string;
31:   attempt: number;
32:   due: number;
33:   lastError?: string;
34: }
35: 
36: export class RetryWheel {
37:   private buckets = new Map<number, RetryItem[]>();
38:   private ids = new Set<string>();
39:   readonly resolution: number;
40:   constructor(resolution = 100) {
41:     this.resolution = resolution;
42:     if (resolution <= 0) throw new RangeError("resolution");
43:   }
44:   add(item: RetryItem) {
45:     if (this.ids.has(item.id)) return false;
46:     const tick = Math.ceil(item.due / this.resolution);
47:     const bucket = this.buckets.get(tick) ?? [];
48:     bucket.push({ ...item });
49:     this.buckets.set(tick, bucket);
50:     this.ids.add(item.id);
51:     return true;
52:   }
53:   advance(now: number) {
54:     const boundary = Math.floor(now / this.resolution);
55:     const ready: RetryItem[] = [];
56:     const ticks = [...this.buckets.keys()].filter((tick) => tick <= boundary).sort((a, b) => a - b);
57:     for (const tick of ticks) {
58:       for (const item of this.buckets.get(tick)!) {
59:         this.ids.delete(item.id);
60:         ready.push(item);
61:       }
62:       this.buckets.delete(tick);
63:     }
64:     return ready;
65:   }
66:   remove(id: string) {
67:     if (!this.ids.delete(id)) return false;
68:     for (const [tick, bucket] of this.buckets) {
69:       const remaining = bucket.filter((item) => item.id !== id);
70:       if (remaining.length) this.buckets.set(tick, remaining);
71:       else this.buckets.delete(tick);
72:     }
73:     return true;
74:   }
75:   get size() {
76:     return this.ids.size;
77:   }
